rows.label: qst202003_msg0001
rows.name:
So you've come to get firewood
in place of Musubi-san?

rows.label: qst202003_msg0002
rows.name:
That's too bad. I won't be able
to meet Musubi-san today.

rows.label: qst202003_msg0004
rows.name: Ah, sorry. It's just a joke.

rows.label: qst202003_msg0005
rows.name:
The firewood is in the scrap wood
area, so take as much as you like.

rows.label: qst202003_msg0006
rows.name:
By the way, is old man
Dofusei doing well?

rows.label: qst202003_msg0008
rows.name:
Old man Dofusei and the others
did a lot for me back then.

rows.label: qst202003_msg0009
rows.name:
He's Superbian, but he liked Torigo
so much that he settled here.

rows.label: qst202003_msg0010
rows.name:
Until recently, he was
teaching Gulan Drivers.

rows.label: qst202003_msg0011
rows.name:
His legs and back couldn't take it
anymore, so he retired...

rows.label: qst202003_msg0012
rows.name:
But this is no time for me to ramble.
Hurry and take the firewood to her.
